fits_in_body.note: battery bay and switch pocket lie inside the body cylinder

walls.note: measured on the pockets' extreme vertices (battery bay, sounder, switch pocket) against the body radius; 1.6 mm printable minimum ASSUMED

trigger_travel.note: travel at the finger; the tactile switch's real travel is a datasheet item

selector.note: three detents at least 10 mm apart on the collar so the thumb can find each

no_magnet_no_metal.note: all printed PETG; sounder must be a magnet-free piezo or a remote sounder; the pod sits about 0.9 m from the head (not a field zone) but the cable pair runs to it

power_button.note: far enough from the selector (>= 30 mm) that the thumb cannot confuse them, directly above the trigger (thumb rest), recessed so it cannot be pressed by a knock

battery.note: ASSUMED 80 x 30 x 24 mm bay; the battery budget (7S pack, START_HERE step 4) sets the real cavity

sounder.note: ASSUMED 24 mm piezo disc under a drilled grille on the thumb side

selector.note: ASSUMED ball-detent collar around the body, three detents 30 deg apart, three icon windows

power.note: recessed momentary push button on TOP above the trigger (thumb position while the index finger is on the trigger); hold 2 s on / off so a knock cannot switch it; a light-pipe ring around it shows green on, amber boost, red low battery. It drives the PM2 power-path controller (soft latch); the PM2 fuse stays in series. Button part ASSUMED (a sealed 12 mm tactile, IP67 class)

trigger.note: ASSUMED index-finger lever on the underside with a tactile switch behind it; double-press is read in firmware
